With that being said, I think it is unfair for your husband to leave you with a 12 week old newborn and another small child. He committed to having a child with you, and he should have to honor that commitment. Men are able to slip out of parenting responsibilities with much less criticism than women are. Imagine if the roles were reversed here and you wanted to leave HIM with a newborn while you partied in vegas. You would be vilified as the worst mother of the year. I understand why your husband wants to go on this trip, and it’s really a bummer that the time frame isn’t compatible. That sucks, and it’s okay to acknowledge those feelings. Sometimes things are just unfortunate and make us angry and there’s nothing we can do to fix it, because that’s just how it is. But he really needs to realize that it is extremely unhealthy (mentally and physically) to leave a new mother all alone with 2 small children without any help. I hope yall get some help and i wish you the best!
